term: cause of a contingent thing or situation (A1)
definition: A1 uses an unqualified cause of a contingent thing or the entire contingent sum, allowing a cause or partial cause in its derived conclusions. The source does not give a detailed typed causal or temporal semantics on A1c, so this is an explicitly uninterpreted sense rather than a definition that asserts actual causal priority or sufficient explanation.
